change: The shared runtime assigns at most 60 seconds to root webchat/telegram requests with a supplied agent_config explicitly declaring difficulty_class=simple. This does not depend on the calendar feature. Existing shorter deadlines remain shorter. Goals, parented/delegated work, resumes, planning/deep modes and benchmarks retain their existing policy. Deterministic calendar confirmation handling is preserved.
audit_evidence: A private-database test uses an automatically assigned shortened test deadline and stalls acceptance delivery. No execution starts; the real tracking DAL persists a timeout with the original request identity and assigned deadline, recoverable through the ordinary outcome reader.
checks: Ruff lint/format and diff checks pass; no size cap increased.
limits: Only explicitly simple configurations supplied at runtime admission are newly bounded. Normal chat that loads a manifest later, and automatic natural-language classification, remain open. This does not prove the general 60-second simple-action acceptance target. No model selection, production write or deployment. Broad engine regression recorded at the preceding revision remains historical; the listed selections validate this change.
